sql: WITH ranked_pay AS (SELECT f.family_label, f.comp_mid_usd, c.company_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.family_label ORDER BY f.comp_mid_usd DESC) as rank FROM fct_posting f JOIN dim_company c ON f.company_key = c.company_key WHERE f.is_open = true AND f.remote_us = true AND f.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL) SELECT family_label, comp_mid_usd, company_name FROM ranked_pay WHERE rank = 1
